Scrambled egg whites, about 250 g at roughly 52 kcal/100 g, give 130 kcal (more if oil was used). Roasted sweet potato, about 100 g at roughly 120 kcal/100 g with oil, gives 120 kcal. Together that is about 350 g and 250 kcal; I rounded up to 280 kcal to allow for cooking oil.

{"kcal": 280, "mass_g": 350}
